+import { describe, expect, it, beforeEach } from 'vitest'
+import { resetDbForTests } from '../../src/server/db'
+import { checkout, getAnalytics, getCart, getCatalog, toggleFavorite } from '../../src/server/queries'
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDbForTests()
+})
+
+describe('database marketplace calculations', () => {
+  it('ranks, filters, and counts catalog prompts in SQL', () => {
+    const catalog = getCatalog({ model: 'GPT-4o', sort: 'featured' })
+    expect(catalog.prompts.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4)
+    expect(catalog.prompts.every((prompt) => prompt.model === 'GPT-4o')).toBe(true)
+    expect(catalog.counts.total).toBe(18)
+    expect(catalog.counts.free).toBe(1)
+    expect(catalog.counts.paid).toBe(17)
+    expect(catalog.prompts[0].rankScore).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(catalog.prompts.at(-1)!.rankScore)
+  })
+
+  it('computes cart subtotal, platform fee, and total from database rows', () => {
+    const cart = getCart()
+    expect(cart.items.map((item) => item.id)).toEqual([142, 207])
+    expect(cart.subtotalCents).toBe(2100)
+    expect(cart.feeCents).toBe(168)
+    expect(cart.totalCents).toBe(2268)
+  })
+
+  it('computes creator revenue, conversion, AOV, category revenue, and trends', () => {
+    const analytics = getAnalytics()
+    expect(analytics.grossRevenueCents).toBe(11100)
+    expect(analytics.creatorRevenueCents).toBeGreaterThan(8500)
+    expect(analytics.platformRevenueCents).toBeGreaterThan(1000)
+    expect(analytics.conversionRate).toBeCloseTo(4 / 28, 3)
+    expect(analytics.averageOrderValueCents).toBe(2775)
+    expect(analytics.categoryRevenue.length).toBeGreaterThan(3)
+    expect(analytics.dailySales).toHaveLength(4)
+  })
+
+  it('persists favorites and checkout mutations through SQLite', () => {
+    const favorite = toggleFavorite(142)
+    expect(favorite.isFavorite).toBe(true)
+    const result = checkout()
+    expect(result.ok).toBe(true)
+    expect(getCart().items).toHaveLength(0)
+    expect(getAnalytics().grossRevenueCents).toBe(13200)
+  })
+})
*** End Patch

+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { resetDbForTests } from '../../src/server/db'
+import { getAnalytics, getCatalog, getCart, getPrompt, setCartItem } from '../../src/server/queries'

+  resetDbForTests()

+    expect(detail?.creator).toBe('Ops Guild')
+    expect(detail?.isInCart).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  it('mutates cart state and recomputes totals after backend calls', () => {

+    expect(next.items.some((item) => item.slug === 'socratic-tutor')).toBe(true)
+    expect(next.subtotalCents).toBe(2100)
+    expect(next.totalCents).toBe(2268)
+    setCartItem(207, false)
+    expect(getCart().subtotalCents).toBe(1200)
+  })
+
+  it('returns analytics summaries shaped for the admin route/API', () => {
+    const analytics = getAnalytics()
+    expect(analytics.creators).toHaveLength(4)
+    expect(analytics.creators[0]).toHaveProperty('conversionRate')
+    expect(analytics.categoryRevenue[0].revenueCents).toBeGreaterThan(0)
+  })
+})

+  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'GPT-4o' })).toBeVisible()
+  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Featured' })).toBeVisible()
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Search' }).click()

+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /Preview Meeting -> Memo/ }).click()

+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to Cart' }).click()
+  await expect(page.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Added')
+  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open detail' }).click()
+  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Meeting -> Memo' })).toBeVisible()
+  await page.goto('/cart')
+  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Checkout simulation' })).toBeVisible()
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay with demo balance' }).click()
